name: Saving Red-Flag Alpha from Witches' Sex Party
source:
The story centers on Yuu, a transmigrator pulled into the chaotic world of [i]To Be Your Rotten Sword[/i], an infamous Omegaverse Webtoon. Alongside fellow transmigrator Katoria, Yuu plans to sit back and let the original story run its course, knowing the story's happily ever after ending.

But fate has other plans when Yuu encounters one of the webtoon’s infamous love interests: the cursed Knight, Leaden—dubbed a "red-flag Alpha" by Katoria.

Later, Yuu must make decision: stick to the sidelines as planned or change the story, even if it means sacrificing the world's eventual peace.

[From [url=https://narurinya.itch.io/sarefa]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事以穿越者悠为中心，他被拉入臭名昭著的Omegaverse网络漫画[i]《成为你的烂剑[/i]》的混乱世界。优计划与穿越者卡托利亚一起坐下来，让原来的故事顺其自然发展，因为他知道故事的结局将永远幸福。

但当悠遇到网络漫画中臭名昭著的恋人之一时，命运却另有安排：被诅咒的骑士利登——被卡托利亚称为“红旗阿尔法”。

随后，悠必须做出决定：按照计划坚持袖手旁观，还是改变故事的发展，即使这意味着牺牲世界最终的和平。

[来自[url=https://narurinya.itch.io/sarefa]Itch.io[/url]]
